whatIs.title: What Is a Microdermabrasion Facial?
whatIs.p1: Facial microdermabrasion is a professional exfoliation treatment designed to support skin renewal through protocols focused on improving the appearance of facial texture, radiance, and overall skin appearance.
whatIs.p2: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center, every protocol is personalized according to your skin’s needs because we understand that every face requires unique care.
whatIs.p3: This treatment can complement advanced skincare routines and help visibly revitalize the skin through an aesthetic experience focused on facial wellness and progressive results.

testimonials.title: What Our Clients Say
items: “My skin felt so much fresher and brighter after my first session.”
“I loved it because my face had a natural glow without looking artificial.”
“The experience was incredibly relaxing and personalized.”

items.a: It is generally a comfortable and well-tolerated procedure. Individual experiences may vary depending on skin sensitivity and the protocol selected.
Many people notice a feeling of freshness and improved radiance after their first sessions, although results can vary depending on each person’s skin.

items.q: Can microdermabrasion help with facial texture?
items.a: The treatment is designed to support facial renewal protocols and a more even-looking appearance of the skin.
Most people can continue their usual activities while following the recommended hydration and sun-protection guidelines.

items.q: Can it be combined with other facials?
items.a: Yes. Depending on your professional assessment and skincare goals, microdermabrasion may be combined with other facial protocols.
Each protocol is personalized according to your skin’s individual needs and goals.
